comments:
Although no signature or catalogue number is visible on the cover page, this version appears to correspond to item kept at the Cultural Palace of Nationalities in Beijing (CPN) under No. 4343(7), which is reported in <<van der Kuijp 2016 [2X2E3882]>>: 251 to bear the signature "phyi la 189" in red, and "nga 414" in black.
In first signature suggests that it was originally part of the 'Bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang collection. [8H6M69W4] does not list any item with the signature "phyi la 189."
